newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products firm on futures, Iraqi concerns.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firm on futures, Iraqi concerns.

text.p: NWE oil products were all stronger. Gasoline was firmer with futures and an open arbitrage window to the U.S.
Naphtha was firmer with crude, with two fresh North African cargoes seen emerging soon, which will boost liquidity.
Gas oil was stronger on futures. Cargo premiums were firm, but barge market was dead ahead of Thursday's Sept IPE expiry.
Fuel oil barges hit post-Gulf War highs at $116 fob ARA, up $7, on Iraqi concerns, improved bunker demand and some tightness.
